Q9019.reason: Sprint ADP breakdown through AMP deaminase and the purine pathway raises blood ammonia, hypoxanthine, and uric acid; urea, creatine, and creatinine are not ADP-degradation products, so C and D are wrong.

Q9020.reason: The delivered entirety deed gave Kathy the condo by survivorship outside probate and is not undone by a prenup that only waives statutory marital rights, including Florida pretermitted-spouse rights, so the pasture still goes to Tommy and the residue is split.

Q9021.reason: Custom shutters screwed into the window frames were annexed as fixtures and passed with the realty even though the contract was silent; frame repairs and warranty-deed title covenants do not defeat that claim.
